notes.title: Performance update
notes.content:
Three quick fixes:
[list]
[*] Locked framerate to 60, instead of, "Whatever your machine can handle."
[*] Increased the resolution of some of the planetary UI elements so that they aren't pixelated, specifically in the first mission.
[*] Created a 700ms buffer between when a dialogue screen closes and when you can launch a probe, to prevent accidental lanches.
[/list]

notes.title: Translation tweaks, better onboarding
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Some elements of the Portuguese translation have been adjusted.
[*] The Portuguese translation has a correctly translated story-complete screen.
[*] Slight reduction in difficulty to Mission 22.
[*] Translator now appears in the credits. 
[*] Velocity can no longer be adjusted in missions 1-3, to prevent new players from putting themselves in a bad state.
[*] Story missions with the Explorer goal now end immediately when you meet the goal, to prevent confusion.
[/list]

notes.title: Audio fixes and celebration
notes.content:
Fixed some issues with how music and sound settings persisted between session.

Also added a new visual/audio sequence to when you hit target worlds or get new high scores in Explorer.

notes.title: Expedition intro text update.
notes.content: Pat of the dialog that introduces players to Expedition Mode was too long and truncating, so we've spit that into different frames.
